S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Incoming proactive instructions become stored tasks; subsequent user management instructions update or cancel those tasks.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Retrieved interaction history informs responses, while retained proactive tasks govern continuing notification behavior.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: Agent-generated task proposals supply monitoring targets to visual-similarity interpretation, directing what incoming frames are checked for.
A->S.locator: [Paper §4.3](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.27074v1#S4.SS3), candidate proposals and proposal–frame embedding comparisons.

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: Interaction Memory resolves ambiguous instruction references before frame-conditioned generation: retained context informs interpretation of user input within the fused Response Tool.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Agent-created monitoring tasks and assistant answers enter Proactive Memory and Interaction Memory, respectively.
A->M.locator: [Paper §4.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.27074v1#S4.SS2); assets/IPI-Agent.png, Memory Tool panel, including the retained answer at t2.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: Interaction Memory retains assistant answers for subsequent contextual use.
record.locator: [Paper §4.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.27074v1#S4.SS2); assets/IPI-Agent.png at the specified commit, Interaction Memory panel.
record.quote: Section 4.2: "an Interaction Memory for storing historical interactions to enhance current user queries with contextual information." Architecture figure, Interaction Memory: "[t2] In the fridge."

outcome.label: not_stated
outcome.rationale: No retained feedback or consequences of delivered assistance are specified; follow-up queries alone do not establish outcomes.
outcome.locator: [Paper §§3.1, 4.2–4.3](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.27074v1); README.md:71–99 distinguishes inference outputs from subsequent benchmark scoring.

attribution.label: not_stated
attribution.rationale: Gating checks pending triggers against current visual evidence, without linking an assistance outcome to its decision; benchmark evaluators operate externally.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: User-directed task edits change task state; no autonomous durable revision of the assistance mechanism is reported.
revision.locator: [Paper §§4.2–4.3](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.27074v1#S4), task management and empirically chosen gating thresholds.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Reported runs evaluate configured components, without identifying runs under a service-revised mechanism.

notes: The checkout matches the specified commit. README.md:124–126 identifies the released scripts as reference evaluation code and lists IPI-Agent code as coming soon. Full-agent judgments therefore rely on the paper and architecture text; baseline scripts and offline scoring are not treated as the full implementation. Retention is established within streaming interactions; cross-session persistence is unspecified.
